**Interface** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public interface IPrinter
```

A printer that can accept print jobs.

Safe to use from several threads at once, for example to submit several jobs together.

## Properties

### AppliedOptions

```csharp
PrintOptionKinds AppliedOptions { get; }
```

Gets the settings of [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/) this printer applies to a job.

A printer from [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/) refuses a job that sets anything else to other than its default, with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception), before anything is sent, rather than printing as if it weren't set. That matters for settings a later version of Latiprimere adds, which a print system written for this one wouldn't know to apply. A setting the printer applies may still be refused for a job, as when the printer lacks the paper size asked for.

The default implementation gives every setting this version of [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/) has. A print system that applies a setting added later says so by overriding this.

### Info

```csharp
PrinterInfo Info { get; }
```

Gets information about the printer, as read when the printer was looked up.

It isn't updated afterwards: to see the printer's current state, use [IPrinter.GetStatusAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#getstatusasync).

## Methods

### GetCapabilitiesAsync

```csharp
Task<PrinterCapabilities> GetCapabilitiesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Reads what the printer can do: paper sizes, duplex, colour, copies, orientation and paper sources.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

The capabilities. Anything the print system doesn't report is left empty.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system or printer couldn't be asked.

### GetDetailsAsync

```csharp
Task<PrinterDetails> GetDetailsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Reads what the printer reports about itself beyond printing: its web pages, pictures of it, its firmware, and how it can be identified.

CUPS queues and network printers report them over IPP. A Windows queue reports them only through its IPP printer, with `WindowsOptions.PrintPdfOverIpp` on; otherwise, and when that printer can't be reached, its details are empty. The default implementation gives details with the printer's ID and nothing else.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

The details. Anything the print system doesn't report is left empty.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system or printer couldn't be asked.

### GetFeature

```csharp
T? GetFeature<T>()
```

Gets what a printer of one print system offers beyond [IPrinter](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/), such as `Latiprimere.Windows.IWindowsPrinter`, or `null` if it offers none of that kind.

Use this rather than a cast: printers from [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/) are Latiprimere's own, around the print system's, so a cast to a print system's interface fails where this finds it. The default implementation casts this printer.

**Type parameters**

- `T`: The interface asked for.

**Returns**

The printer as `T`, or `null`.

### GetJobAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrintJob?> GetJobAsync(string jobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Finds a job submitted to this printer earlier, by its [IPrintJob.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintjob/#id), so it can be followed or cancelled after the application has restarted.

**Parameters**

- `jobId`: The job's identifier, as [IPrintJob.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintjob/#id) gave it.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

The job, or `null` if the print system no longer knows it, or it was never submitted to this printer. Print systems forget finished jobs: printers and CUPS after a while, and Windows as soon as the job has printed, unless the printer is set to keep printed documents. So a job that isn't found has most likely finished, but whether it printed can't be told.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `jobId` is `null`.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system or printer couldn't be asked.

### GetStatusAsync

```csharp
Task<PrinterStatus> GetStatusAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Reads the printer's current state from the print system.

The default implementation gives the state in [IPrinter.Info](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#info), as read when the printer was looked up.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The printer's current status.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system failed to report the printer's state, or no longer has the printer.

### IdentifyAsync

```csharp
Task IdentifyAsync(string? message = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Asks the printer to make itself known, so it can be told from others nearby: it flashes, beeps, shows a message or speaks, as it does by default.

[PrinterDetails.IdentifyActions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerdetails/#identifyactions) says how the printer can make itself known. CUPS queues and network printers are asked with IPP's Identify-Printer, which IPP Everywhere printers take. A Windows queue can be identified only through its IPP printer, with `WindowsOptions.PrintPdfOverIpp` on. The default implementation throws [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

**Parameters**

- `message`: A message to show on the printer's display, if it has one, such as "This is Office Laser"; or `null` for none. At most 127 bytes in UTF-8.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

A task that completes once the printer has been asked.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): `message` is longer than 127 bytes in UTF-8.
- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): The printer, or its print system, can't be identified.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system or printer couldn't be asked.

### PrintTestPageAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrintJob> PrintTestPageAsync(PrintOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Prints a test page Latiprimere draws: the printer's name and address, what its capabilities say, a line a quarter of an inch in from each edge, two rulers, and colour and grey patches.

The page is a PDF, printed as any PDF is. A side of the edge line that doesn't print is outside what the printer can print, and rulers shorter than they say mean the page was scaled. On paper too small for it, such as a label, the page is shrunk to fit and says so.

The default implementation throws [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

**Parameters**

- `options`: How to print the page, as for [IPrinter.SubmitAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#submitasync). Use [PrintOptions.Default](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#default) for printer defaults. The page goes on the job's paper, else the printer's default.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the submission. Cancelling does not cancel the job once it has been accepted.

**Returns**

The page's job, which can be used to follow its progress.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `options` is `null`.
- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): The printer can't print the page, as for a PDF it can't print, such as a Windows queue without a PDF rasteriser.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system rejected or failed to accept the job, or the printer's capabilities couldn't be read.

### SubmitAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrintJob> SubmitAsync(PrintContent content, PrintOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Submits a document to the printer.

**Parameters**

- `content`: The document to print.
- `options`: How to print the document. Use [PrintOptions.Default](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#default) for printer defaults.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the submission. Cancelling does not cancel a job once it has been accepted.

**Returns**

The submitted job, which can be used to follow its progress.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `content` or `options` is `null`.
- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): The printer cannot accept documents in the content's format.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system rejected or failed to accept the job.

### WatchStatusAsync

```csharp
IAsyncEnumerable<PrinterStatus> WatchStatusAsync(TimeSpan pollInterval, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Follows the printer's state, reporting each change as it happens, until cancelled.

The Windows spooler signals each change to a printer, so its state is read when one comes, and at least every 30 seconds. CUPS and network printers are read every `pollInterval`. A state that can't be read, as when the printer is off or the network drops, is reported as [PrinterState.Unknown](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerstate/#values) with why as its message, and the watch goes on, reporting the printer's state again once it can be read. The default implementation reads [IPrinter.GetStatusAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#getstatusasync) every `pollInterval`.

**Parameters**

- `pollInterval`: How long to wait between reads of the state when the print system can't say when it changes, so it is polled.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to stop following the printer.

**Returns**

The printer's status, then each change of its state, message, reasons or whether it accepts jobs, never twice the same. A printer has no final state, so this goes on until `cancellationToken` is cancelled, which ends it with [OperationCanceledException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.operationcanceledexception).

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): `pollInterval` is zero or negative.
